title: Monte Carlo: 200 equity paths from one edge
caption: Same 52% win rate, 1:1.2 reward-to-risk, 2% risk per trade — 200 runs of 200 trades. The shaded cone is the 10th–90th-percentile band: a real positive edge still spreads outcomes from roughly +20% to +130%, every path tours a deep drawdown, and a handful break −25% first. Size for the band, not the median.
